datasets.name: UR Fall Detection
datasets.citation: Kwolek & Kepski, UR Fall Detection Dataset
datasets.annotation: First frame annotated 'lying' (dataset's own per-frame labels)
datasets.onset_note: Onset is a fixed 30 frames before impact on all 30 falls, so the falling phase adds no information beyond the impact frame on this dataset.

datasets.name: Le2i / ImViA
datasets.citation: Charfi et al., Le2i fall detection dataset (Home and Coffee room scenes)
datasets.annotation: Annotated fall END frame (dataset's own annotation)
datasets.onset_note: Onset-to-impact varies from 1 to 45 frames and is genuine annotation.

limits: Falls are ACTED by volunteers - not recorded elderly falls.
Neither dataset publishes actor identity, so splits are clip-independent, not subject-independent, and may overstate performance on unseen people.
Pose coverage drops after impact: the estimator struggles with a person on the floor.
